meta.name: Ride with Norman Reedus
meta.description:
The Walking Dead star and motorcycle enthusiast Norman Reedus hits the open road to explore local biker culture and celebrate the best and brightest collectors, mechanics and craftsmen around the country. Each episode features Reedus and a riding companion – a fellow actor, musician, friend or local chopper fanatic – as they journey to custom bike shops, tattoo parlors, collector’s warehouses, or a roadside smokehouse… with plenty of time for unplanned detours and tire changes.

Rated TV-14 · Returning Series · First aired 12 Jun 2016 · United States · Language: English
Studio: AMC Studios, Left/Right · Network: AMC

videos.title: Death Valley: Dante's View
videos.overview: Balthazar Getty and Norman Reedus spend a night in Las Vegas and then ride out to Death Valley, enjoying the epic scenery.

videos.title: Appalachia: Blue Ridge Parkway
videos.overview: Norman and his buddy Jason snake through the smokey mountains, hit the Dragons Tail, and party with the locals.

videos.title: Texas: Twisted Sister
videos.overview: Norman takes a ride from Austin to San Antonio, Texas.

videos.title: Louisiana: Crescent City
videos.overview: Norman takes a ride from Lafayette, La., to New Orleans.

videos.title: The Keys with Peter Fonda
videos.overview: In the first-season finale, Norman Reedus rides with Peter Fonda from Naples to Key West in Florida.

videos.title: Spain with Jeffrey Dean Morgan
videos.overview: Norman and his "The Walking Dead" castmate Jeffrey Dean Morgan ride through Spain; starting in Barcelona and ending at the Falles festival in Valencia.

videos.title: Lowcountry with Dave Chappelle
videos.overview: Norman and comedian Dave Chappelle ride from Charleston to Savannah, stopping along the way to experience the culture and history of Lowcountry.

videos.title: New Mexico: White Sands
videos.overview: Norman and musician Aimee Nash ride from Albuquerque to White Sands, NM, where they ride ziplines, eat chili, and test out government grade weapons.

videos.title: My New York
videos.overview: Norman rides around his home city of New York while visiting friends, exploring the city's art, food and culture.
